title: bird bed cover set
text: bird bed cover set. I really wanted to love this.. I love the 100% cotton.. the print is really pretty - but a dirty beige background. Wish it were lighter.  The material seems really lightweight. I am nervous about how thin the back of the sham is.  I worry about tears as you try to fit your fluffy (in my case memory foam) sham pillows into them.  And finally it came removed from its original bag and put into a non commercial vacuum seal bag for mail. There had to be a lot of hands touching it. Eh.  Further, I ordered a second and it was sent the same way.  Disappointing.  I would have preferred it stayed in it's original packing and messing with original seal.  The vacuum sealing did very, very little in sizing. So I wonder why we couldn't have the original bag.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
